[ ila + ṇa ]  CL=7 A sheep. See - Eḷacamma.

eḷeyya: [ yādicchakanāma ] (pu) CL=7 (A king) is named Eḷeyya.

eḷikakumāra: [ eḷika + kumāra ] (pu) CL=7 A young man is named Eḷika.
eḷikakumāraka: [ eḷika + kumāraka ] (pu) CL=7 A young man is named Eḷika.

eḷā: (1) Spittle. (2) Saliva. (3) A cardamom (plant). See - Ela, eḷa.
